caseName: The Man at the Night Desk
title: Ines & Theo

questions.text:
Okay. His phone's in my hand and my hands are shaking 😳
He's worked that desk for months. Every time I come home late, he's just there, watching.
I only know him as Theo from the desk.
What's his last name?

That's a name I can say out loud. Somehow that's worse.
He never talks to me. Just nods. But I can feel he talks about me to someone 😤
What does he call me when he talks about me?
questions.hint: Read his chats in Messages with the person he texts most.

questions.text:
A nickname. Like I'm a character in his little show 🤢
He sits down there all night, every night. I bet he knows exactly when things happen on my floor.
How many nights over the past 14 days has he been keeping track of?
questions.hint: Look in Notes for something he keeps night by night, and only count the dates inside the past two weeks.

questions.text:
Nine nights isn't a coincidence, that's a schedule 😳
Someone's been sending me shots of myself through my window. Me cooking. Me asleep on the couch.
I couldn't look at them anymore.
How many of those shots of me does he have?
questions.hint: Open Photos and look for a group of images that are all of the same thing, then count them.

questions.text:
He kept every single one 💔
The roses at my door are always dead, black at the edges. Once there were fresh ones too, no card.
If he bought flowers for me, where did he get them?
questions.hint: Look for flower shops in RevoBank, then check Messages to see which purchase was for her.

questions.text:
Flowers. From him. I put them in a vase like an idiot 😤
I teach three classes and only post the schedule on the studio's site.
Which of my classes does he keep track of?
questions.hint: Look in Calendar for an event that isn't his own plans, maybe marked with the nickname you already found.

questions.text:
My late class. The one where I walk home in the dark 😳
My mom always said, watch what a man spends money on, that's what he's planning.
What else did he buy the same week as those flowers?
questions.hint: Look in RevoBank for a store around the flower purchase, then check Safari to see what the product was.

onboarding.text: Someone has been leaving dead roses at my door for weeks. Then came the messages: shots of me, taken through my own window, at night. I barely sleep now. I keep the lights off.
onboarding.label: Ines

onboarding.text: Theo works the night desk in my building. When I moved in, he carried my reformer box up nine floors because the elevator was out. I thought he was sweet. Now I'm not sure of anything.
onboarding.label: Ines & Theo

onboarding.text: He's always down there, all night, watching the lobby, barely saying a word. Tonight he left his phone on the mail counter, still unlocked. I took it before I could talk myself out of it.
onboarding.label: Theo

onboarding.text: I know it's him. I just need proof before I go to the police, before he notices it's gone. Help me get through his phone, please. Tell me I'm not crazy.
onboarding.label: Ines
